scripts.install:all: npm --prefix app install && npm --prefix functions install && npm --prefix firebase install && npm --prefix server install
scripts.emulators: npm --prefix functions run build && firebase emulators:start --project demo-tutordesk --config firebase/firebase.json
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix app run typecheck && npm --prefix functions run typecheck && npm --prefix firebase run typecheck && npm --prefix server run typecheck
scripts.lint: npm --prefix app run lint && npm --prefix functions run lint && npm --prefix firebase run lint && npm --prefix server run lint
scripts.test: npm --prefix app test -- --ci && npm --prefix functions test
scripts.test:emulator: firebase emulators:exec --config firebase/firebase.json --only firestore,storage "npm --prefix firebase test && npm --prefix functions test"
scripts.test:rules: firebase emulators:exec --config firebase/firebase.json --only firestore,storage "npm --prefix firebase test && npm --prefix functions test"
scripts.test:server: npm --prefix server run db:start && npm --prefix server test
